about: The state of every step under one statement — the read-out that
A single label per statement cannot: two cells of the four-by-four
stay undecided by the labels alone. Each step carries two booleans
Only the DEMAND side carries a state, so this walks the steps a
statement can demand — not the ones it can limit. An implementation
walking every level instead would produce one entry too many on a
ladder and get the bottom wrong.
The crossed case is the one that matters: a statement nothing can
satisfy still has a read-out, and CONFLICT appears step by step.

coverage.criterion: all four states, each reachable, plus a pinned level and a crossed statement
coverage.why: one scale only; that the read-out combines coordinatewise is asserted exhaustively in the unit tests
